title: The Update Nobody Asked For
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：feature　|　正文 398 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 feature 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother's first phone had three buttons and a torch. Her second had everything, and the ① feature she liked best was the one nobody had designed: pressing the same button twice rang me. Every app on that screen was a ② feature somebody had been paid to invent, and not one of them was as useful as the accident. On video calls her ③ features were always two seconds behind her voice, which she considered a fault in my hearing rather than in the network.

I work for a small company that makes software for village shops. Our product had a single ④ feature that mattered — it worked without a signal — and eleven that did not. In January we shipped an update whose main ⑤ feature was a new colour for the buttons, and a woman in the next county rang to ask where her stock list had gone. Features, I have learned, are what a company sells; reliability is what a shop buys.

The meeting after that was short. We cut eight things. What survived was ⑥ a safety feature that locks the till after nine at night, and a plain page that loads in two seconds on a bad connection. Both are invisible, and both are the reason anybody still ⑦ features our software on their counter at all. In February the county paper ran a ⑧ feature on village shops, and our name appeared in the last paragraph, which our manager framed.

In March I went to the shop myself. The owner showed me the things he actually used: the stock list, the refund button, which ⑨ features in nearly every complaint we receive, and a trick for photographing deliveries. He had been using all three for four years and had never once opened anything else. He asked whether we could put the beep back that he had liked in the old version, and I had to tell him it had never existed.

I think about that beep often. The best feature of any tool, I now believe, is the one the user has already invented in their head. Being ⑩ featured in a trade magazine, our manager pointed out, had never brought us a single customer. Ours, meanwhile, keeps growing: a new feature every quarter, a chart for every manager, and one small box in the settings that still says, in six languages, that the software will work without a signal.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 特征；特点；特色
B. n. （软件、设备的）功能；性能
C. n. （报纸、网站的）特写；专题报道（a feature on）
D. v. 以……为特色；摆放；展示（feature sth）
E. v. 起重要作用；出现于（feature in）
F. 固定搭配：safety feature 安全装置；安全功能
G. 固定搭配：be featured in 被刊载于；被重点推介
H. n. 面容的一部分；五官（常用复数 features）

items.q: Every app on that screen was a feature
On video calls her features were always two seconds behind
Our product had a single feature that mattered
whose main feature was a new colour
What survived was a safety feature
anybody still features our software on their counter
the county paper ran a feature on village shops
which features in nearly every complaint
Being featured in a trade magazine

answers.why: 指手机上的“功能”，而这个最好的功能并非有意设计，只是误打误撞。
屏幕上每个应用都是有人领薪水发明出来的“功能”。
features 指“五官、面容”，说视频通话里她的口型总比声音慢两秒。
产品唯一真正有价值的“特点”：无信号也能用。
更新的主要“功能”只是把按钮换了颜色。
safety feature 意为“安全功能”，此处指九点后锁钱箱的装置。
feature 作动词，意为“摆放、以……为特色”，此处说柜台上仍摆着我们的软件。
a feature on ... 意为“关于……的专题报道”，指县报那篇写乡村店铺的文章。
feature in 意为“出现于、在……中占重要位置”，说退款键几乎出现在每份投诉里。
be featured in 意为“被刊载于、被重点推介”，指上了行业杂志却没带来顾客。

task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 她最喜欢的功能根本不是谁设计的。（feature）
我们的产品只有一项特点真正重要。（feature）
那次更新的主要功能只是换了个按钮颜色。（main feature）
保留下来的是一项九点后锁钱箱的安全功能。（safety feature）
退款键几乎出现在我们收到的每份投诉里。（feature in）
被行业杂志重点推介从未给我们带来一位顾客。（be featured in）

Our product had a single feature that mattered.
The main feature of that update was a new colour for the buttons.

Being featured in a trade magazine had never brought us a single customer.
